verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions emergency-stop, safety interlocks, or any documented safety pattern. It covers only general building blocks: predefined commands (e.g., return to home), event-triggered commands, teleoperation controls, and anomaly alerts. A developer could use these to construct safety behaviors, but they are not a documented e-stop or interlock capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a robotics engineer, I can implement emergency-stop and safety-interlock patterns the platform documents and supports
